args.lesson: Worked: a one-function patch with an exact-string assert in core.js, substituting the core into preview.html instead of rerunning build.py. build.py would have inserted the index links a second time, because the site index already contains them. Both observed invalid dates are now not determinable. Results: parity 33/33, UI 15/15, deadline regression 39/40, new digest e42aad73. The boundary tests also found that Python fromisoformat in reconcile.py accepts the invalid offset +05:60 (read as +06:00). That is the single intended divergence and it is documented. Next time, boundary-test the reference implementation as well as the port: the paid script carries the same class of defect.
